entities.summary: Ashraf Abouelhassan Mahmud is an Egyptian indoor volleyball player. He was included in the Egypt men's national volleyball team that finished 11th at the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney, Australia. He is setter and is 184 cm tall. He plays for Zamalek
